Round 2 · Implementation · Medium

Ticket #10 — Notification Delivery

Difficulty: Medium

Context

You maintain notifications for completed reports. An event ID identifies one recipient/message pair. The producer may resend that event after an uncertain response. Deduplication means that replaying a successfully sent event must not contact the provider again. The supplied recording provider is an in-memory fake.

Practice report

With a provider that succeeds, call deliver("evt-1", "riley", "Your report is ready") twice.

Observation Current starter Expected
Provider calls 2 1
Stored attempt count for evt-1 2 1
Stored delivery status sent sent

A single stored row is insufficient evidence of one send; inspect provider calls as well as delivery records.

Acceptance Criteria

  • An exact replay after success returns the sent record without another send or attempt. Reusing an event ID for a different recipient or message raises ValueError without changing the original delivery or calling the provider.
  • Persist the delivery's incremented attempt count and sending state before each provider call, then persist its outcome.
  • With the default limit of 3, outcomes [False, False, True] end in sent after 3 attempts. Three failures leave a persisted failed record.
  • retry(event_id) may resume a failed record with another bounded set of attempts; attempt history accumulates. A successful later attempt can move it to sent.
  • Retrying a sent record has no additional effect. Retrying an unknown event raises KeyError without creating a record.

Out of Scope

Use the included store and provider fake. Real email/SMS services, backoff scheduling, crash recovery across processes, and new payload-validation rules are outside this ticket.

Investigation

Trace submission and operator retry through the delivery store and provider. Add assertions for persisted attempts, status, and provider calls on success, replay, transient failure, and exhausted retries. Keep request identity and side effects consistent across those paths.
